correctness.rationale: Finite T0 spaces are exactly Alexandrov spaces of their specialization posets. The published poset L-algebra construction x·y=1 when x≤y and y otherwise has nonempty upper-set ideals. A proper upper-set ideal is prime precisely when its finite complementary lower set has one maximal element t, hence is Ω\downarrow t. Explicit inverse image of U_I is I∩T, recovering all open upper sets. Empty T gives the one-element algebra with empty prime spectrum. This all-size proof does not rest on five-point checker outputs.
